name: Competent Automobiles Company Limited
summary: Competent Automobiles Company Limited (COMPEAU.BO) operates within the automotive industry, primarily dealing with the retail and maintenance of vehicles. Its business activities are organized into two distinct departments: the Showroom division and the Services & Spares division. The Showroom segment is responsible for the procurement and sale of automobiles produced by Maruti Suzuki India Ltd. In parallel, the Services & Spares segment offers repair and upkeep for Maruti vehicles, in addition to distributing their genuine spare parts. The company was established by Raj Chopra on April 11, 1985, and its corporate headquarters are located in New Delhi, India.
